Feb. 7, 40.
1.

ARREST OF UNIFORMED MEMBERS OF THE PEACE NATIONAL
CONSTRUCTION ARMY.

At 9.10 a.m. 7-2-40, Sergeant Bullard, East Surrey
Regiment i/c of a British Military Patrol, took into
custody, and escorted to Ash Camp, 65 Great Western Road,
a group of six male Chinese dressed in dark blue coloured
uniforms and Chinese Military Caps, armed with two old
Military rifles and 30 rounds of ammunition, who were
marching northwards along Edinburgh Road near Great
Western Road.

Following the apprehension of the above men, Major
Ashmore, Brigade Major, British Forces, Tifeng Road Camp,
notified Mr. MacDermott, D.O."B", who, instructed that
detectives from Bubbling Well Station attend for the
purpose of interrogation.

D.I.Tabrum, D.S.I.Chi Chi Huang and D.S.Till, who
attended, ascertained the men to be as follows:-

1. Zao Seu Ching (曹守卿),Sergeant, age 26, Ningpo.
2. Heo Sz Tze (胡世志),Pte. age 28, Ningpo.
3. Zee Bei Sung (徐培生),Pte. age 24, Changchow.
4. Lee Ching Hse (李清華),Pte. age 22, Wuzih.
5. Hsu Yeang Kwei (許榮貴), Pte. age 19, Yencheng.
6. Sung Too Ching (沈祖德), Pte. age 30, Zanshing.

Questioned, the men stated that they were members of
a Pre Veng Ching Wei Unit, designated, as the Peace

1.

逮捕身着制服的和平建国军成员。

1940年2月7日上午9时10分，东萨里团（East Surrey Regiment）布尔拉德（Bullard）中士率领一支英军巡逻队，在大西路附近的爱丁堡路向北行进时，将一群共六名身穿深蓝色制服、头戴中式军帽、持有两支旧式军用步枪及30发子弹的中国男子拘捕，并押送至大西路65号阿什营（Ash Camp）。

在上述人员被捕后，提丰路营地英军旅参谋长阿什莫尔（Ashmore）少校通知了“B”区巡官麦克德莫特（MacDermott）先生，后者指示静安寺捕房的侦探前往进行审讯。

到场的探目塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）、副督察黄吉吉（Chi Chi Huang，音译）及侦探蒂尔（Till）查明这些人身份如下：

1. 曹守卿（Zao Seu Ching），中士，26岁，宁波人。
2. 胡世志（Heo Sz Tze），列兵，28岁，宁波人。
3. 徐培生（Zee Bei Sung），列兵，24岁，常州人。
4. 李清華（Lee Ching Hse），列兵，22岁，吴淞人。
5. 許榮貴（Hsu Yeang Kwei），列兵，19岁，盐城人。
6. 沈祖德（Sung Too Ching），列兵，30岁，嘉兴人。

经讯问，这些人声称他们是汪精卫下属的一个单位成员，该单位被称为和平

Misc.No.93/40.
1/2.

National Construction Army. Their Office was situated
at Tse Yue Pang Village (諸安浜), off Edinburgh Road,
S.C.G.P.B., under the command of one named Wong Kyi
(汪清) whose Headquarters is at 116 Tunsin Road,
Tel. No.22838.

There were also two other groups consisting of
seven men in each. One of which was quartered at
Headquarters, and the other stationed at Wu Ka Koh
Village (吳家角) off Great Western Road, S.C.G.P.B.

The group to which they were attached had been
formed about four months previously, at a monthly pay of
$12.00 (which had not yet been paid).

They received two meals a day which was supplied
by Wong Kyi, who also issued them with their uniforms and
arms.

They had been told upon enrolment that they were
part of an immense army which was being formed under the
auspices of Wang Ching Wei. Their previous occupations
with the exception of the 1st named who was a soldier in
the Chinese Nationalist Army, were given as Mill coolies
and hawkers.

On the person of the 1st named was found a piece of
red paper on which the following Chinese characters were
inscribed: (有福同享有難同當)
pages.zh:
杂项号：93/40.
1/2.

建国军。其办事处位于公共租界中区戈登路（即爱丁堡路）旁的诸安浜村（Tse Yue Pang Village），由一名叫汪清（Wong Kyi，音译）的人指挥，其总部设在敦信路116号，电话22838。

另有两组人员，每组七人。其中一组驻扎在总部，另一组驻守在公共租界中区大西路旁的吴家角村（Wu Ka Koh Village）。

他们所属的小组大约于四个月前成立，月薪为12.00元（尚未支付）。

他们每天获得两餐，由汪清供应，汪清还向他们发放制服和武器。

他们在入伍时被告知，他们是汪精卫主持组建的一支庞大军队的一部分。除第一名被列者曾是中国国民革命军士兵外，其余人之前的职业均为码头苦力和小贩。

在第一名被列者身上发现一张红纸，上面写有以下汉字：（有福同享有難同當）

Louza
7th Dec., 1941.

Misc.845/41.

1.

Member of the Peace Construction Army
arrested by Reserve Unit.

At 10 a.m. 7/12/41 R.U.C.14 Shestakoff Reserve
Unit, brought to the Station a male Chinese as
follows:-

Tung Ching Sung (陳錦声) 21, Tungchow,
M/soldier, holding the rank of sergeant
in the Peace Construction Army, 34 Ming
Ying Road, Nantao.

who he had arrested while on search party on Yu Ya Ching
Road near Avenue Edward VII.

It appears that R.U.C.14 while serving as a
member of the R.A.D. had performed guard duty on the
"Lone Battalion" internment camp, Singapore Road,
and stated that he recognized the above described
arrested man as being one of the escaped soldiers
from the camp.

C. I. Tatchell, Liaison Officer to the R.A.D.
was informed and on his instructions the arrested
man was taken to the camp.

However the commandant of the interned battalion,
Major Lee Yoong failed to identify him stating that
the arrested man was not one of his battalion.

D.O."A" informed of the above and on his
instructions, the arrested man was escorted to the
Settlement boundary (Stone Bridge) and released.

1941年12月7日。

杂项号：845/41.

1.

预备队逮捕的一名和平建国军成员。

1941年12月7日上午10时，预备队第14分队谢斯塔科夫（Shestakoff）分队将一名中国男子带至捕房，详情如下：

陈锦声（Tung Ching Sung，音译），21岁，通州人，军人，在和平建国军中担任中士，住址南市明英路34号。

此人是在爱德华七世大道附近的虞洽卿路执行搜查任务时被捕的。

据悉，预备队第14分队成员此前曾在皇家空军防卫队（R.A.D.）服役，并在新加坡路“孤军营”战俘营执行警卫任务，他声称认出上述被捕者是该营逃出的士兵之一。

已通知皇家空军防卫队联络官塔切尔（Tatchell）首席督察，根据其指示，将被捕者送往该营。

然而，被拘留营地的指挥官李勇（Lee Yoong，音译）少校未能辨认出此人，并称被捕者并非其营部人员。

已将上述情况通知“A”区巡官，根据其指示，将被捕者护送至租界边界（石拱桥）并予以释放。

1/3.

“我们将同甘共苦”，由他及其分队的其他五名成员签署。

这些人穿着的制服上别着一块布制识别章，一面印有佩戴者的编号和照片，并盖有和平建国军的印章。另一面则注明佩戴者的姓名、军衔及所属小组。

每个人的左臂上都别着一块布质徽章，国民党党徽图案内有一个“汪”字。

这些人称，被捕时他们正奉汪清之命前往总部，在春节期间执行额外的警卫任务。

已通知政治部，副督察麦卡迪（McAdie）和副督察廖增基（Liao Tseeng Kyi，音译）到场。
